objectTypes.name: abh.action-authorization-request
objectTypes.description: Immutable caller request for Action preparation and authorization; never execution authority.

objectTypes.name: abh.action-cleanup
objectTypes.description: Immutable proof of zero-dispatch authorization cleanup.

objectTypes.name: abh.action-result
objectTypes.description: Immutable complete Action result and verified one-shot resource settlement.

objectTypes.name: abh.attempt
objectTypes.description: Immutable identity of one external call.

objectTypes.name: abh.attempt-observation
objectTypes.description: Append-only execution-state evidence for an Attempt.

objectTypes.name: abh.dispatch-exit
objectTypes.description: Durable one-use exit claim; possible transmission remains uncertain until evidence.

objectTypes.name: abh.dispatch-permit
objectTypes.description: Short-lived permit for exactly one Attempt and Worker lease.

objectTypes.name: abh.durable-wakeup
objectTypes.description: Immutable notification to the waiting Owner; does not decide business outcome.

objectTypes.name: abh.exception
objectTypes.description: Responsibility case bound to immutable contradictory terminal evidence.

objectTypes.name: abh.exception-resolution
objectTypes.description: Immutable responsibility disposition while preserving technical Unknown evidence.

objectTypes.name: abh.exception-resolution-effect
objectTypes.description: Immutable governance effect that releases only the reviewed report hold.

objectTypes.name: abh.exception-successor-dispatch
objectTypes.description: Immutable proof that one resolved exception was handed to its governed successor handler.

objectTypes.name: abh.correction-application
objectTypes.description: Immutable Subject Owner application result for one correction candidate.

objectTypes.name: abh.correction
objectTypes.description: Immutable human correction candidate that never auto-applies to the current subject.

objectTypes.name: abh.inbox
objectTypes.description: Immutable consumer result for one committed source event.

objectTypes.name: abh.operation-wait
objectTypes.description: Operation reconciliation waiting intent and notification.

objectTypes.name: abh.outbox-consumption
objectTypes.description: Immutable evidence that all frozen Outbox consumers committed their Inbox effects.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-trust-policy
objectTypes.description: Versioned deployment trust policy for one Pack namespace.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-validation
objectTypes.description: Immutable Pack validation evidence; installation requires current deployment governance.

objectTypes.name: abh.ledger-correction
objectTypes.description: Immutable signed Ledger correction from a verified source observation.

objectTypes.name: abh.unit
objectTypes.description: Immutable monetary or quantity measurement unit.

objectTypes.name: abh.period
objectTypes.description: Immutable accounting period bound to Ledger configuration.

objectTypes.name: abh.policy-version
objectTypes.description: Immutable compiled policy version and provenance.

objectTypes.name: abh.query-capture
objectTypes.description: Durable capture of independently authorized read-only query observations.

objectTypes.name: abh.query-exit
objectTypes.description: One-use independently authorized read-only query exit.

objectTypes.name: abh.resource-fence
objectTypes.description: Exclusive unresolved external-operation slot and fencing generation.

objectTypes.name: abh.graph-revision
objectTypes.description: Bounded Task Graph revision and dependency closure.

objectTypes.name: abh.checkpoint
objectTypes.description: Verified Run recovery index over Tasks, outputs, waits and resource usage.

objectTypes.name: abh.secret
objectTypes.description: Secret binding reference; material is held by the Secret adapter.

objectTypes.name: abh.transport-capture
objectTypes.description: Immutable transport observation and raw receipt capture for a committed exit.

objectTypes.name: abh.work-lease
objectTypes.description: Finite worker ownership; grants no business authority.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-data-impact
objectTypes.description: Immutable deployment-bound Pack data impact evidence.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-migration-attempt
objectTypes.description: Immutable deployment-global claim for one physical Pack migration; not an execution permit.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-migration-observation
objectTypes.description: Immutable database execution observation; not result verification.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-inspection-job
objectTypes.description: Durable structure and data inspection progress owned by PackLoader.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-inspection-delivery
objectTypes.description: Immutable acceptance of an exact inspection Job lifecycle event; not execution success.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-deployment-revision
objectTypes.description: Immutable organization deployment revision binding a committed Pack transition.

objectTypes.name: abh.pack-capability-set
objectTypes.description: Immutable complete static capability registration set; installation state controls runtime visibility.

objectTypes.name: abh.invocation-observation
objectTypes.description: Append-only evidence from a Worker whose execution lease has expired.

objectTypes.name: abh.invocation-adjudication
objectTypes.description: Current Run Owner decision to adopt or reject late Invocation evidence.

objectTypes.name: abh.learning-case
objectTypes.description: Governed evidence attribution case; does not confer knowledge qualification

objectTypes.name: abh.learning-candidate
objectTypes.description: Draft capability candidate; evaluation and release are separately authorized

objectTypes.name: abh.evaluation-profile
objectTypes.description: Immutable governance-owned evaluation suite, dataset, metric and stopping rule binding

objectTypes.name: abh.evaluation-run
objectTypes.description: Governed offline evaluation execution binding a candidate to one frozen profile and baseline

objectTypes.name: abh.evaluation-result
objectTypes.description: Immutable evaluator result for one exact evaluation run and frozen profile

objectTypes.name: abh.learning-gate
objectTypes.description: Immutable independent gate verdict built from exact evaluation evidence

actions.name: abh.artifacts.tombstone
actions.description: Apply retention or deletion governance to artifact metadata after physical deletion is confirmed.

actions.name: abh.actions.aggregate
actions.description: Finalize a complete Action child vector and verified resource settlements.

actions.name: abh.actions.cleanup
actions.description: Safely clear a zero-dispatch authorization before cancellation, expiry or reauthorization.

actions.name: abh.actions.notify-wait
actions.description: Current admission for durable wait integration.

actions.name: abh.actions.pin
actions.description: Pin required Action capabilities using current preparation Grants, without execution authority.

actions.name: abh.actions.register-plan
actions.description: Register a compiled Action plan under current preparation Grant and pinned capabilities.

actions.name: abh.actions.validate
actions.description: Validate frozen Action input against current Domain evidence; internal preparation only.

actions.name: abh.exceptions.open-terminal
actions.description: Open a responsibility case for a currently frozen terminal contradiction.

actions.name: abh.exceptions.resolve
actions.description: Record an approved responsibility disposition without changing the unresolved technical outcome.

actions.name: abh.execution-authority.create
actions.description: Current management permission for finite execution delegation from Scope policy or complete Action approval.

actions.name: abh.operations.apply-reconciliation
actions.description: Current Controller applies complete comparison evidence to an existing operation.

actions.name: abh.operations.capture-query
actions.description: Capture query evidence with current independent observation permission.

actions.name: abh.operations.capture-transport
actions.description: Persist transport evidence without execution authority or outcome changes.

actions.name: abh.operations.claim-query-exit
actions.description: Read-only query of an existing dispatched operation with independent authority.

actions.name: abh.operations.notify-wait
actions.description: Record current reconciliation waiting notification.

actions.name: abh.operations.reconcile
actions.description: Compare all persisted evidence under a pinned rule; does not dispatch or change an outcome.

actions.name: abh.operations.record-receipt
actions.description: Append authenticated evidence for an existing operation, without outcome mutation or dispatch authority.

actions.name: abh.operations.safe-retry
actions.description: Reauthorize a bounded retry of a deterministic transport failure with the same Provider idempotency key.

actions.name: abh.operations.recover
actions.description: Recover an expired possible-in-flight Permit as Unknown while retaining its resource responsibility.

actions.name: abh.runs.recover
actions.description: Cancel nonterminal Task facts and clear a stale Mission active-run reference after a terminal Run.

actions.name: abh.runs.wake
actions.description: Resume a Waiting Run only after its durable wait has succeeded and the Mission still owns the Run.

actions.name: abh.runs.stop-stalled
actions.description: Atomically stop a Run whose fixed no-progress deadline has expired.

actions.name: abh.graph-patches.propose
actions.description: Propose a bounded acyclic Task Graph revision against the current base.

actions.name: abh.tasks.claim
actions.description: Claim a Ready Task under a short-lived durable execution lease.

actions.name: abh.invocations.prepare
actions.description: Create an immutable TaskSpec-bound Created Invocation under the current lease.

actions.name: abh.invocations.finalize
actions.description: Fix Manifest, Bindings and Contract Digest before Task enters Running.

actions.name: abh.invocations.complete
actions.description: Persist the Invocation result and move its Task to verification or failure.

actions.name: abh.invocations.observe-late
actions.description: Preserve expired-lease Invocation evidence without changing execution state.

actions.name: abh.tasks.commit-verified

actions.name: abh.projections.build-mission-summary
actions.description: Reauthorize durable MissionSummary source rebuild under Projection Owner authority.

actions.name: abh.packs.record-validation
actions.description: Record verified Pack evidence under deployment administration authority.

actions.name: abh.responsibilities.revoke
actions.description: Revoke a responsibility assignment after current management and continuity checks.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.expire
actions.description: Expire overdue responsibility requests and pending decisions without approval effects.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.open
actions.description: Open a governed responsibility request under current routing authority, without approval or execution permission.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.retry-route
actions.description: Retry current eligibility for an unchanged Unresolved responsibility request.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.revise-route
actions.description: Revise frozen responsibility routing with current governance and source evidence.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.delegate-slot
actions.description: Delegate one frozen responsibility seat through governed route revision.

actions.name: abh.responsibility-requests.escalate-slot
actions.description: Escalate one unresolved responsibility seat to the next governed candidate.

actions.name: abh.runtime.cancel-wait
actions.description: Current server admission for durable waiting.

actions.name: abh.runtime.consume-event
actions.description: Consume one committed event with its Owner effect in the same transaction.

actions.name: abh.runtime.execute-wait-port
actions.description: Current admission for durable wait integration.

actions.name: abh.runtime.prepare-outbox
actions.description: Persist frozen Outbox fanout and per-consumer queue publication facts.

actions.name: abh.runtime.recheck-wait
actions.description: Current server admission for durable waiting.

actions.name: abh.runtime.record-outbox-consumption
actions.description: Record actual Inbox completion for every consumer of a frozen Outbox routing.

actions.name: abh.runtime.record-outbox-delivery
actions.description: Persist frozen Outbox fanout and per-consumer queue publication facts.

actions.name: abh.runtime.register-wait
actions.description: Current server admission for durable waiting.

actions.name: abh.packs.publish-trust-policy
actions.description: Publish independently signed deployment governance under current administration authority.

actions.name: abh.packs.stage
actions.description: Stage verified durable Pack content under current deployment governance.

actions.name: abh.packs.record-data-impact
actions.description: Record recomputed data impact under current compiler and deployment authority.

actions.name: abh.packs.request-inspection
actions.description: Request bounded asynchronous inspection of an exact staged installation.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.start
actions.description: Start an exact inspection Job under a current fenced work lease and cumulative budget.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.expire
actions.description: Fail an expired inspection Job using database-time evidence without requiring a surviving worker lease.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.complete
actions.description: Complete inspection from authentic produced state and an authorized stored observation under a live lease.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.wait
actions.description: Record a real preparation blocker under current lease and remaining cumulative budget.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.cancel
actions.description: Cancel inspection under current governance and actual cancellation evidence; preserve exhausted budget as failure.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.accept-delivery
actions.description: Persist a committed inspection lifecycle event in the Inbox transaction without management execution authority.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.fail-lost-lease
actions.description: Settle a Running inspection after authoritative expired or replaced lease observation, retaining cumulative budget.

actions.name: abh.pack-inspection-jobs.fail
actions.description: Settle an actual failed inspection attempt under its current lease and independent failure authority, retaining cumulative budget.

actions.name: abh.packs.record-conformance
actions.description: Record signed CTK evidence under independent deployment evidence authority.

actions.name: abh.packs.request-enable
actions.description: Request Human approval for an exact currently verified Pack deployment proposal.

actions.name: abh.packs.enable
actions.description: Enable an exact Pack after current deployment verification and bound Human approval.

actions.name: abh.packs.register-capabilities
actions.description: Reserve verified static capability identities for a staged Pack without enabling runtime use.

actions.name: abh.packs.suspend
actions.description: Suspend an Enabled Pack while retaining all historical references.

actions.name: abh.packs.retire
actions.description: Retire an exact suspended Pack after reference and rollback-window review; retained bytes are not deleted.

actions.name: abh.operations.record-compatible-query-evidence
actions.description: Record reviewed exact-operation compatibility evidence without granting a query exit or dispatch authority.

actions.name: abh.learning.capture-signal
actions.description: Capture a purpose-authorized learning signal with source and scope bindings.

actions.name: abh.learning.build-case
actions.description: Attribute governed signals and current evidence into a Learning Case without knowledge qualification.

actions.name: abh.learning.create-candidate
actions.description: Create a Draft capability candidate from an exact Learning Case without evaluation or release authority.

actions.name: abh.learning.request-evaluation
actions.description: Request an offline evaluation by freezing the registered profile for an exact candidate and baseline.

actions.name: abh.learning.retry-evaluation
actions.description: Retry an exact inconclusive evaluation run with frozen evaluation inputs.

actions.name: abh.learning.submit-evaluation-result
actions.description: Submit immutable evaluator results and complete an exact queued evaluation run.

actions.name: abh.learning.expire-evaluation
actions.description: Recover a timed-out evaluation run as Inconclusive without inventing evaluator evidence.

actions.name: abh.learning.build-gate
actions.description: Build an immutable independent Gate verdict from exact evaluation evidence without creating a Release.

actions.name: abh.releases.configure-learning-candidate
actions.description: Consume a passing immutable Learning Gate and configure a governed Release and Assignment without automatic promotion.
